{
  "root_cause": "Multiple keydown listeners accumulate in the navigation controller because a new listener is added on every results render without removing the previous one, causing stale focus state and incorrect selection when Enter is pressed.",
  "repair_strategy": "Modify the navigation controller to remove any existing keydown listener before adding a new one, storing the listener reference on the input field to prevent duplication.",
  "edits": [
    {
      "path": "src/controllers/navigationController.js",
      "sha256": "cb38337c041e8e0543c4f7b31666374956d6dc85011604e12ff127c9bf67ddde",
      "before": "  const navigate = config.resultsList.navigation || navigation;\n  /**\n   * @listens {keydown} Listens to all `keydown` events on the input field\n   **/\n  config.inputField.addEventListener(\"keydown\", navigate);",
      "after": "  const navigateFn = config.resultsList.navigation || navigation;\n  // Remove previous listener if exists\n  if (config.inputField._autoCompleteNavigateListener) {\n    config.inputField.removeEventListener(\"keydown\", config.inputField._autoCompleteNavigateListener);\n  }\n  config.inputField.addEventListener(\"keydown\", navigateFn);\n  config.inputField._autoCompleteNavigateListener = navigateFn;"
  }
],
"expected_accessibility_effect": "Keyboard navigation will correctly highlight and select the intended suggestion, ensuring ARIA attributes reflect the active item and preventing duplicate event handlers that could interfere with assistive technology.",
"functional_risks": [
  "If a custom navigation function is provided via config.resultsList.navigation, it will be replaced on each render, which may affect consumers expecting a persistent listener.",
  "The cleanup property _autoCompleteNavigateListener must be considered in any teardown logic to avoid memory leaks."
],
"verification_requirements": [
  "After typing 'bl' and pressing ArrowDown, pressing Enter should set the input value to 'Blackberry'.",
  "Only one keydown listener should be present on the input field after multiple renders.",
  "ArrowUp and ArrowDown navigation should correctly cycle through suggestions across multiple renders.",
  "Pressing ESC should clear the input and close the suggestion list.",
  "Form submission should reflect the correctly selected suggestion."
}
}
